intent: Bedrock's project-wide low-level utility header/implementation: the core types (SString, STable, SException, SStopwatch, SRECompiledRegex), the logging/assertion macros nearly every file uses, and free functions for strings, HTTP wire format, JSON, sockets, files, crypto, and SQLite query execution.

objects.name: STableComp
objects.role: Case-insensitive less-than comparator; STable's key comparator

objects.name: STableComp::nocase_compare
objects.role: Per-character case-insensitive comparator used by STableComp

objects.name: SString
objects.role: String subclass adding implicit assign/construct from bool, char, arithmetic types, and string-convertible types

objects.name: STable
objects.role: Case-insensitive string-to-SString map; the project's canonical name/value table

objects.name: SException
objects.role: Exception carrying an HTTP-like method/headers/body triple plus an optional captured callstack

objects.name: SStopwatch
objects.role: Elapsed-time/alarm timer built on atomic<uint64_t>

objects.name: SRECompiledRegex
objects.role: RAII owner of a compiled PCRE2 regex, move-only

objects.name: SAutoThreadPrefix
objects.role: Scope guard that sets/restores the thread-local log prefix, log param, and command name

objects.name: std::atomic<string>
objects.role: Mutex-backed atomic<string>, filling a standard-library gap

objects.name: fd_map
objects.role: map<int, pollfd> keyed by socket, used by the S_poll family

objects.name: Assertion/exception macros
objects.role: SASSERT, SASSERTEQUALS, SASSERTWARN, SASSERTWARNEQUALS, STHROW, STHROW_STACK

objects.name: Logging macros/globals
objects.role: SSYSLOG, SDEBUG/SINFO/SHMMM/SWARN/SALERT/SERROR, SWHEREAMI, _g_SLogMask, SSyslogFunc, SThreadLog{Prefix,Param,Name,Command}, isSyncThread, isBlockingCommitThread; SSyslogSocketDirect/SSyslogNoop backends and their socket pool are implemented in this .cpp

objects.name: Time functions/macros
objects.role: STIME_US_PER_*, STIME_HZ, STimeNow, STimeThisMorning, SDaysInMonth, SComposeTime, STimestampToEpoch, STimestampMSToEpoch, SToTimeval, SFirstOfMonth - implemented in STime.cpp

objects.name: Signal functions
objects.role: SInitializeSignals, SGetSignal, SCheckSignal, SGetSignals, SGetSignalDescription, SClearSignals, SStopSignalThread - implemented in SSignal.cpp

objects.name: Log-support functions
objects.role: SLogStackTrace, SWhitelistLogParams, SIsLogParamWhitelisted, addLogParams - implemented in SLog.cpp

objects.name: SInitialize/SSetSignalHandlerDieFunc/STerminationSignalCount
objects.role: Process/thread bring-up and shutdown-signal bookkeeping

objects.name: SFluentdInitialize/SFluentdLog
objects.role: Fluentd forward-protocol logging, with per-key redaction and syslog fallback

objects.name: Math/hex functions
objects.role: SToHex (3 overloads), SFromHex, SStrFromHex, SBase32HexStringFromBase32, SHexStringFromBase32

objects.name: String utility functions
objects.role: SToStr, SToFloat/SToInt/SToInt64/SToUInt64, SContains overloads, SIEquals/SIContains/SStartsWith/SEndsWith, SConstantTimeEquals/IEquals, SToLower/SToUpper, SCollapse/STrim/SStrip/SStripAllBut/SStripNonNum/SStripTrim, SEscape/SUnescape, SBefore/SAfter/SAfterLastOf/SAfterUpTo, SReplace/SReplaceAllBut/SReplaceAll, SStateNameToInt, SAppend, SIsValidSQLiteDateModifier

objects.name: Regex functions
objects.role: SRECompile, SREMatch, SREMatchAll, SREReplace, SRedactSensitiveValues

objects.name: HTTP wire-format functions
objects.role: SParseHTTP, SParseRequestMethodLine, SParseResponseMethodLine, SParseURI, SParseURIPath, SComposeHTTP, SComposePOST, SComposeHost, SParseHost, SHostIsValid, SGetDomain, SDecodeURIComponent, SEncodeURIComponent, plus file-local helpers _SParseHTTP_GetUpToNext/_SParseHTTP_GetUpToEnd/_SDecodeURIChar in the .cpp

objects.name: List functions
objects.role: SParseIntegerList/Set/Vector, SParseList, SParseSet, SComposeList

objects.name: JSON functions
objects.role: SToJSON, SComposeJSONArray, SComposeJSONObject, SParseJSONObject, SParseJSONArray, SGetJSONArrayFront, plus the file-local recursive-descent parser (_SParseJSONString/_SParseJSONArray/_SParseJSONObject/_SParseJSONValue) in the .cpp

objects.name: Network/socket functions
objects.role: SToStr(sockaddr_in)/operator<<, SFDset, SFDAnySet, SResolveHost, SIPToAddr, S_socket, S_close, S_accept, S_recvfrom, S_recvappend, S_sendconsume, S_poll, SGetHostName, SGetPeerName, SCheckNetworkErrorType

objects.name: File functions
objects.role: SFileExists, SFileLoad, SFileSave, SFileDelete, SFileCopy, SFileSize

objects.name: Crypto functions
objects.role: SHashSHA1/SHA256, SEncodeBase64/SDecodeBase64, SHMACSHA1/SHA256, SAESEncrypt, SAESDecrypt, SAESDecryptNoStrip

objects.name: SQLite functions
objects.role: SQ (7 overloads), SQList, SQueryLogOpen/Close, SQuery (4 overloads, including a busy-retry loop with named-parameter binding, corruption detection and slow-query logging), SQVerifyTable, SQVerifyTableExists; _g_sQueryLogFP is a file-local global in the .cpp

objects.name: Timestamp functions
objects.role: SUNQUOTED_TIMESTAMP, STIMESTAMP, SUNQUOTED_CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, SCURRENT_TIMESTAMP implemented here; SCURRENT_TIMESTAMP_MS/STIMESTAMP_MS declared here but implemented in STime.cpp

objects.name: Misc functions
objects.role: SGZip/SGUnzip, SParseCommandLine, SExecShell, SGetCPUUserTime, SGetCurrentExceptionName, STerminateHandler

misfits.why: A full SQLite execution engine (busy-retry-on-SQLITE_BUSY loop, named-parameter binding, corruption detection, slow-query logging) declared and implemented in a generic string-utility header/source, while SQResult, SQValue, and SQliteParameter already live in this same directory as their own dedicated units
misfits.suggested_home: A dedicated SQLite-execution unit alongside SQResult/SQValue/SQliteParameter

misfits.why: A complete HTTP wire-format grammar (headers, chunked transfer-encoding, cookie folding, URI parsing) sitting in the generic utility file even though this directory already has a dedicated SHTTPSManager for HTTP transactions
misfits.suggested_home: SHTTPSManager or a new SHTTPMessage unit

misfits.why: Self-contained mbedtls wrappers with no dependency on anything else in this file
Raw socket/poll primitives whose only real caller is STCPManager, the dedicated socket-management class that already lives in this same directory
Gzip compression, unrelated to the string/HTTP/SQL utilities around it; small and self-contained

A complete alternate logging transport with its own per-socket locking, sitting beside unrelated HTTP/JSON/SQL/crypto code, even though SLog.cpp already exists in this directory as the dedicated logging-support unit

Leading-underscore naming signals 'file-private' but none are declared static or placed in an anonymous namespace, so they have external linkage and could collide with an identically-named symbol in another translation unit

name_fit.note: libstuff openly advertises itself as a catch-all, and libstuff/ is the shared-utility directory, so it fits its own name

location_fit.note: Established repo pattern is to carve cohesive slices out of libstuff into their own units (SQResult, SData, STCPManager, SHTTPSManager, SSignal, SLog, STime already did); several slices that fit that pattern (SQL execution, crypto, HTTP wire format) still remain

naming_quality.note: Consistent 'S' prefix on public symbols; fd_map is the one lowercase unprefixed typedef; file-local helper functions use a leading underscore for 'private' but lack real internal linkage
